assessment: The work of Bellotto et al. provides a comprehensive and compelling study of the diffusion of proteins in the cytoplasm of the bacterium Escherichia coli, using multiple measurement methods, notably Fluorescence Correlation Spectroscopy. It is found that fast diffusing proteins roughly follow the Stokes-Einstein relation, while proteins that strongly interact with the cytoplasm manifest subdiffusion. This study will be a valuable resource for scientists seeking to understand the temporal dynamics of proteins within cells.
